# simpledir

> Named directory shortcuts for the shell. The next zoxide: no frecency
> database, no daemon, no shell-injection. One JSON file of `name -> path`
> plus a small shell function that performs the `cd`.

A single-file Python 3.8+ command line tool with zero dependencies. It stores
aliases you name yourself, and jumps to the bound directory. Useful when the
same dozen directories are visited every day and you want them to have names.
Complements, does not replace, [zoxide](https://github.com/ajeetdsouza/zoxide).

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/noxthedevwindev-greatest/simpledir/blob/main/README.md): full documentation
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/noxthedevwindev-greatest/simpledir/blob/main/AGENTS.md): notes for coding agents working on this repository
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/noxthedevwindev-greatest/simpledir/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/noxthedevwindev-greatest/simpledir
cd simpledir && make install
```

Or manually:

```
install -Dm755 simpledir ~/.local/bin/simpledir
simpledir init >> ~/.bashrc
```

## Commands

```
simpledir add <name> [path]   bind a name to a directory; path defaults to $PWD; -f overwrites
simpledir rm <name>           remove an alias
simpledir ls [-l]             list aliases; -l forces absolute paths
simpledir jump <name>         print the bound path to stdout, do not cd
simpledir init                print the shell wrapper to append to a shell rc file
simpledir <name>              in a shell: jump. elsewhere: same as `jump`
```

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` unknown alias or user error, `2` argument parsing
error (argparse).

## Shell wrapper

`sd <name>` and `simpledir <name>` `cd`. This is done by shell functions emitted
by `simpledir init`, because a subprocess cannot change the calling shell's
working directory. The `simpledir` function shadows the binary, intercepting only
bare aliases; `add`, `rm`, `ls`, `jump`, `init` and flags are forwarded to the
real binary via `command simpledir`.

- `sd` with no arguments: `cd $HOME`
- `sd -`: `cd $OLDPWD`

Functions rather than shell aliases, because bash expands aliases only in
interactive shells.

## Configuration

Path: `~/.simpledir/config.json`. Override the directory with the
`SIMPLEDIR_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable. The file is plain JSON and safe to
edit by hand.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "aliases": {
    "dots": "/home/you/dotfiles",
    "hypr": "/home/you/.config/hypr"
  }
}
```

Schema: `version` is an integer, currently `1`. `aliases` maps a non-empty alias
name to an absolute directory path. Writes are atomic: temporary file plus
`os.replace`.

## Behavior on errors

- unknown alias: message with substring and `difflib` suggestions, exit `1`
- alias bound to a deleted directory: `jump` refuses and explains how to rebind;
  `ls` tags it `[missing]`
- duplicate alias: refused unless `--force` is given
- corrupt or unreadable config: explains the problem, suggests removal, does not
  silently reset
- `ls` with no aliases: usage hint on stderr, exit `1`

## Development

```
make test        # 37 assertions, runs real bash subprocesses
vhs docs/demo.tape   # re-record docs/demo.gif (needs vhs and ttyd)
```

Repository layout:

```
simpledir          the entire tool, one executable Python file
tests/run.sh       test suite, plain bash
docs/demo.tape     vhs script that produces docs/demo.gif
packaging/PKGBUILD Arch package definition
Makefile           install / uninstall / test targets
```
